BillHistory.ReferredCommittee: Referred to Committee on Early Learning & K-12 Education.

BillHeading.BriefDescription: Studying outcomes for children in the early childhood education and assistance program.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to studying outcomes for children in the early childhood education and assistance program; creating a new section; and providing an expiration date.

BillSectionHeader.P: (1) Within existing resources, the Washington state institute for public policy must prepare an updated report of the 2014 early childhood education and assistance program outcome evaluation report. To the maximum extent possible, the report must:

BillSection.P: (a) Include an evaluation of the long-term outcomes after 2020 when the children in the analysis are expected to graduate from high school; and
(b) Provide a comparison to evaluations of early and childhood education programs in other states and jurisdictions.

(2) The Washington state institute for public policy must submit a preliminary report to the appropriate committees of the legislature and the governor by December 1, 2020, that describes the work completed. A final report must be submitted to the appropriate committees of the legislature and the governor by January 6, 2021.

(3) At no cost to the Washington state institute for public policy, the department of children, youth, and families and the office of the superintendent of public instruction must provide the Washington state institute for public policy with all data necessary to complete the report.
